intro_text: Our committee comprises passionate medical students from NUS Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, supported by healthcare advisors, doctors, and community partners.

members.name: Project Directors
members.bio: Leading overall strategy, international partnerships, and logistical execution for Project Battambang.

members.name: Medical Screening Committee
members.bio: Designing clinical protocols, triage procedures, pharmacy management, and volunteer physician coordination.

members.name: Education Committee
members.bio: Overseeing the Light-A-Dream Scholarship, school water and sanitation projects, and health education modules.

members.name: Logistics & Finance Committee
members.bio: Managing supply chain, medication logistics, budgeting, transparency, and donation distribution.
